homepagersvp.title: Confirmeu la vostra assistència
homepagersvp.instructions:
Feu-nos saber si podreu assistir a través del formulari de confirmació.
Digueu-nos si veniu acompanyats.

Si us plau, confirmeu la vostra assistència abans del

waves.text: Déu, que és la perfecció de la ciència i de l'amor, només ofereix i accepta la ciència i l'amor perfectes. El tresor sepultat dins la terra. El gran concentrat de l'Univers.
waves.text1: Everything started in a minimal moment, when the world stopped making noise and your name found meaning in my voice. Everything started in a minimal moment, when the world stopped making noise and your name found meaning in my voice.

schedule.title: Informació pràctica

where.title: On
where.place: Restaurant Les Terrasses de Sant Romà
where.address:
Carretera Badalona a Mollet B-500, Km 4,
08391 Tiana, Barcelona

participation.title: Participació
participation.info:
Es cobrarà el mateix dia abans de començar la reunió plenària.
Us agrairem que arribeu amb temps suficient i que porteu els diners justos corresponents (ni Visa, ni talons bancaris), per tal de facilitar el pagament a la direcció del restaurant.

schedule.other: Us demanem que doneu a conèixer aquesta invitació a tots els vostres companys que potser no l’hagin rebut, per tal de que ningú es quedi sense la informació.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description:
A bus will leave from {busOriginName} to the church at {busToCeremonyTime}.
After the ceremony, the same bus will take you to {busToVenueName}.
The bus will return to {busOriginName} at {busReturnTime}.

Please confirm your seat when filling out the form.

We are also providing contact numbers for taxis in the area:

dresscode.title: Dresscode
dresscode.description:
No conditions, just come as you like!
Since the celebration will be held in a garden during the day, just a small recommendation for your comfort...
wide and comfortable heels!

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.description: For those who need accommodation near the celebration, we have prepared a list of our recommendations.

gift.title: Travel
gift.description:
The best gift you can give us is your presence.
But if you would like to make it extra special...
Help us make our trip even more unforgettable!

q1.question: Can children come?
q1.answer: Of course! We love having children as part of the celebration. We have areas dedicated to their fun and safety.

q2.question: Is there parking available?
q2.answer: We have ample parking for all our guests. Please follow the signs upon arrival to find the designated parking areas.

q3.question: What if I have more questions?
q3.answer: We're here to help. If you have any additional questions, please contact us by phone or through our website contact form.

confirmation.title: Gràcies per la vostra resposta!
confirmation.message:
Hem rebut la vostra resposta amb molta estima.
Us hem enviat un correu electrònic de confirmació.
Ens alegra comptar amb vosaltres en aquest dia especial... o tenir-vos presents en esperit. ❤️

hero.title: Plan your event.
hero.subtitle: No stress. No lost messages.
hero.description: A simple, elegant platform to manage invitations, guests, and logistics — all in one place.

preview.text: Replaces WhatsApps + scattered notes with a single, always up-to-date space.

cards.invitationText: Create and manage digital invitations with a clear process and fewer back-and-forth messages.
cards.guestsText: Keep all guests organized in one place with attendance status, plus-ones, and key details.
cards.exportsText: Generate practical exports and PDF summaries to coordinate quickly with vendors and family.
cards.customDesignText: We adapt the design, the colors and tone, and the content so the experience matches your wedding style.
cards.smartPlatformText: Designed to simplify planning in one place: less friction, better visibility, and smoother coordination.

bentos.title: Your entire admin dashboard, in one platform
bentos.subtitle: Clear features to manage everything without unnecessary complexity.

dashboard.title: Admin dashboard
dashboard.text: A global view of your planning status: RSVPs, dietary needs, transport, and more.

rsvp.title: Guest RSVPs
rsvp.text: Structured RSVP tracking: attendance, +1, message, transport and dietary restrictions — with stats.

diets.text: Create menus and automatically assign them to each guest based on dietary restrictions. Track menu totals globally and by table for catering.

seating.title: Seating plan
seating.text: Organize guests between tables, adjust the table layout, and generate PDFs anytime.

playlist.title: Collaborative playlist
playlist.text: Collect song suggestions, curate your personalized list, and export for your DJ.

blog.title: GPL 2026’s blog
blog.text: Post updates and photos to keep everyone informed before the big day.

email.title: Email sending
email.text: Send group emails to segments (attending only, all, etc.) directly from the dashboard.

planner.title: IA planner
planner.text: Describe your context and let AI generate prioritized tasks and a clear calendar you can execute and adapt in seconds.

rsvpForm.title: Custom RSVP form
rsvpForm.text: We configure your RSVP form to collect exactly what you need from guests, with optional fields and clear structure.

budget.title: Budget tracking
budget.text: Set a total budget, plan by category, track paid vs unpaid, and see clear charts at a glance.

agenda.title: Event agenda
agenda.text: Plan the day D step by step, set timings, assign roles and keep the full schedule under control at a glance.

cta.title: Ready to simplify your planning?
